name: Slow Cooker Boneless Beef Short Ribs
why: Verified in-band from source page: 581 cal, 8 g carbs, 39 g protein per serving. Slow-cooker beef braise, no starch base (meat + fire-roasted tomatoes + aromatics), scales cleanly to 14 via weigh-and-divide. Short ribs likely have no board home (board tracks beef-chuck-roast) - flagged for the pricer lane; could be rebuilt on chuck roast if the selector prefers. Clean fit for the low-carb band, mid-upper on calories but well under both gates.
